# openmetadata_chart (Data Source)

Looks up a single OpenMetadata chart by id or fully qualified name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openmetadata_chart" "revenue_by_region" {
  fully_qualified_name = "looker.revenue_by_region"
}

output "revenue_by_region_chart_id" {
  value = data.openmetadata_chart.revenue_by_region.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `fully_qualified_name` (String) Chart fully qualified name. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.
- `id` (String) Chart UUID. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.

### Read-Only

- `chart_type` (String) Chart visualization type.
- `dashboards` (List of String) Fully qualified names of the dashboards the chart is placed on.
- `description` (String) Markdown description.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name.
- `name` (String) Chart name.
- `service` (String) Fully qualified name of the dashboard service that owns the chart.
- `source_url` (String) URL of the chart in the source BI tool.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time in RFC 3339 format.
- `updated_by` (String) User that performed the last update.
- `version` (Number) Server-side entity version.
